conventions.reference_note: The data is a 2014-15 snapshot, so relative dates count back from the latest date stored in schools.OpenDate, not from today.

sat_math_avg.label: Average SAT Math score
sat_math_avg.definition: Mean of the school-level average SAT Math score.
sat_math_avg.aggregation: average of school averages (not weighted by test takers)
sat_math_avg.include: rows where satscores.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
sat_math_avg.exclude: schools with no reported SAT scores (NULL)
sat_math_avg.time_basis: 2014-15 school year snapshot (satscores has no date column)

sat_reading_avg.label: Average SAT Reading score
sat_reading_avg.definition: Mean of the school-level average SAT Reading score.
sat_reading_avg.aggregation: average of school averages (not weighted by test takers)
sat_reading_avg.include: rows where satscores.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
sat_reading_avg.exclude: schools with no reported SAT scores (NULL)
sat_reading_avg.time_basis: 2014-15 school year snapshot (satscores has no date column)

sat_writing_avg.label: Average SAT Writing score
sat_writing_avg.definition: Mean of the school-level average SAT Writing score.
sat_writing_avg.aggregation: average of school averages (not weighted by test takers)
sat_writing_avg.include: rows where satscores.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
sat_writing_avg.exclude: schools with no reported SAT scores (NULL)
sat_writing_avg.time_basis: 2014-15 school year snapshot (satscores has no date column)

sat_1500_rate.label: Share of SAT takers scoring 1500+
sat_1500_rate.definition: Test takers with a total SAT score of at least 1500, divided by all test takers.
sat_1500_rate.aggregation: pooled ratio of sums (weighted by test takers); per school: CAST(NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NumTstTakr
sat_1500_rate.exclude: schools with zero test takers or NULL NumGE1500
sat_1500_rate.time_basis: 2014-15 school year snapshot (satscores has no date column)

frpm_rate.metric: Poverty rate (free or reduced-price meal eligibility)
frpm_rate.label: Share of K-12 students eligible for free or reduced-price meals
frpm_rate.definition: Students eligible for free or reduced-price meals divided by K-12 enrollment.
frpm_rate.formula: frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` per school; overall: SUM(frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)`) / SUM(frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`)
frpm_rate.aggregation: per school: stored percentage (0-1, not 0-100); across schools: ratio of sums

enrollment_k12.label: K-12 enrollment
enrollment_k12.definition: Number of students enrolled in grades K-12 on census day.
